scope: C1/C3 metadata only; identity record used to deduplicate 27 candidates, not to certify a reference; full shared source files hashed but no held-out results re-evaluated

shared_qualification_review.event_interpretation: event roles/windows are predeclared, but no independent isolated-event certificate is supplied for these slots
shared_qualification_review.F0_contamination: no per-slot frozen-window norm(M F0)/norm(M delta) certificate identified in reviewed metadata; a ratio alone would not establish purity
shared_qualification_review.delta_attribution: pair differences can contain multiple changed interactions; event overlap and COV application across cases prevent assuming a unique pure component
shared_qualification_review.numerical_sensitivity: family-anchor magnitude-spectrum/grid-tier diagnostics exist; they do not certify each slot time-real NRMSE or its PML/source sensitivity budget

constructed_ladder_reference.kind: complete_clean by construction for whole-array consistency only
constructed_ladder_reference.note: separate object class, not an additional physical reference slot
